## Description and Rationale

I am a aerospace engineering master student. I have always been interested in the organization of air traffic control and airports, therefore during my bachelor degree I took many courses related to this subject which allowed me to visit and learn from major airports in Europe. I would like to use my knowledge in AI and coding to try to solve this interesting task, my university professor suggested me to apply for this challenge, hence I think I possess the ability and knowledge to optimize the current airports prediction system.
